newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich air cargo traffic up 4.8 pct in Jan-Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: Zurich air cargo traffic up 4.8 pct in Jan-Feb 97.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport in January-February 1997 was up 4.8 percent on the first two months of last year at 69,222 tonnes, airport authority figures show.
January-February 1997 cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich increased by 2.5 percent on 1996 levels to 38,007 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up 1.8 percent to 11,553 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight handled at grew by 11.4 percent on January-February 1996 to 19,662 tonnes, the airport authority said.
January-February 1997 postal traffic handled totalled 3,075 tonnes, up 16.8 percent on the same 1996 period.
